description:
Ready to build Japanese words one character at a time?

HIRAGANA Word Challenge is a casual quiz game where you use the illustration as a clue and choose the hiragana that completes the word. It’s a fun way to connect pictures, words, and kana while building the basics of Japanese.

How to play is simple:
・Look at the illustration
・Check the word with one missing hiragana
・Choose the right answer from four options
・Read the explanation to learn more

After each question, you can review helpful notes about meaning, usage, related expressions, and bits of Japanese culture connected to the word.

The short, quick questions make it easy to play during a break. Great for beginners, anyone brushing up on hiragana, and families who want to enjoy Japanese language and culture together.
